research_period: Milan, Paris and Pitti Uomo menswear shows, June 2026; Premiere Vision Paris, February 2026; analysis July to November 2026
markets: Global: Milan, Paris and Florence runways; premium and mid-market menswear
title: SS27 Men's Woven Silhouette Direction
summary: Lighter, closer and shorter: soft summer suits, long trousers cut closer to the body, cropped jackets and shorts, from tailored Bermudas to boxer shorts.

sections.heading: The evidence
sections.body: Milan showed lighter, less oversized tailoring with open necklines and more airflow, long trousers cut closer to the body, cropped leather jackets and five-pocket slim trousers<sup>[1]</sup>. In Paris, collections kept to cleaner, more minimal, straight-edged silhouettes; classic suiting was loosened, and black suits sat alongside smart shorts and athletic shapes at Dries Van Noten, Louis Gabriel Nouchi, Egonlab and Ami<sup>[2]</sup>. Micro jackets (shrunken peacoats, collarless truckers, bombers and blousons) and boxer shorts were among the season's defining shapes<sup>[3]</sup>. Thom Browne showed pleated skirts for men<sup>[1]</sup>.

sections.heading: Shapes to lead with
sections.body:
- **Soft summer suit:** unlined, softer shoulder, lighter double-breasted versions.
- **Closer straight trouser:** long, closer to the leg, with a single pleat or flat front.
- **Cropped jacket:** blouson, trucker or micro peacoat ending at the waist.
- **Shorts:** tailored Bermudas, suit shorts and smart shorts.
- **Camp and tunic shirts:** for sets and pyjama-inspired looks.

sections.heading: Shapes to watch
sections.body: Boxer shorts as outerwear and skirts for men are early, fashion-customer ideas<sup>[3]</sup><sup>[1]</sup>. Very oversized tailoring is giving way to lighter, closer cuts<sup>[1]</sup>.

timing: In stores February to July 2027. Closer trousers and cropped jackets are rising; Forecut expects the closer line to continue into AW27.
products: - Summer suits, straight trousers, Bermudas and suit shorts, cropped blousons, camp and tunic shirts.
design_implications:
- Slim trouser blocks slightly from SS26 relaxed fits, keeping room at the seat.
- Shorten jacket blocks; adjust pocket placement for cropped lengths.
- Develop suit shorts with the same cloth as jackets.
commercial_implications:
- Shift part of the wide-trouser buy into straighter, closer fits.
- Sell suit shorts as part of a suit offer for hot markets.
